shared_elements: carved standing/frontal anthropomorphic figure on an upright stone monument
headdress or elaborate head element above the figure
low-relief carving covering the whole face of an upright slab
circular/disc motifs on the body or field
symmetrical vertical composition about a central axis
justification: Both are upright slab monuments bearing a frontal, axially symmetrical anthropomorphic figure with an elaborated head/headdress at top, disc motifs on the torso area, and relief filling the whole face. But A shows a densely packed, multi-register composition with small glyph-like blocks and subsidiary figures in narrative panels, whereas B is a single large, sparsely detailed schematic figure with broad plain surfaces and no register divisions or sign-like blocks, so the manner of depiction differs strongly.
